timeoutPrompts: Andiva: Hello? You took the call just to give me silence?
Andiva: Darling, my time is billable by the second. Are you there?
Andiva: I have a runway rehearsal to run. Speak or I'm hanging up.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Andiva: Finally. I just wrapped the fitting. Tell me honestly—did you see the moodboard I sent earlier?

choices.choiceText: A bit daring, don't you think?

nodes.partnerDialogue: Andiva: Naturally. I spent three weeks sourcing the velvet alone. You have an eye for high fashion.

choices.choiceText: Save me a seat in the front row.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Andiva: Daring is the entire point. Safe fashion is boring fashion. You'll see once the models walk.
Andiva: Don't take all season. Trends wait for no one. Text me when you finish the third page.
Andiva: If only you saw the sewing cuts on my fingers. But thank you, {PlayerName}. Speak soon.
Andiva: Reserved under your name already. Don't be late. Ciao.
